releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.0.10 - DeckAcoustix DSP: Independent Tempo & Pitch Shifter
releaseNotes: Introducing DeckAcoustix DSP: proprietary studio-grade decoupled tempo (0.50x to 2.00x) and pitch (-6.0 to +6.0 semitones) shifter powered by software WSOLA time-stretching and native C++ 8-comb 4-allpass Schroeder-Freeverb algorithmic reverberation. Features 1-tap studio presets (Slowed + Reverb, Nightcore, Sped Up, Lofi Chill, Normal), continuous fine sliders with haptic center snaps, live reverb parameters, and dual-deck crossfade parameter synchronization.
